title: Sprint 4 - Basic Retrieval & Filtering
description: Complete all MongoDB queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Fetch All Users
tickets.description:
Retrieve all columns and all rows from the `users` collection.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT * FROM users;
```
tasks: Retrieve all columns and all rows from the `users` collection.
learning_objectives: The find() statement to fetch all documents.

tickets.title: DISTINCT Retrieval
tickets.description:
Fetch a list of all unique statuses currently present in the `todos` collection. Note that while SQL DISTINCT returns a result set of rows, MongoDB's `distinct()` method returns a raw JavaScript array of unique values.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT status FROM todos;
```
tasks: Fetch a list of all unique statuses currently present in the `todos` collection. Note that while SQL DISTINCT returns a result set of rows, MongoDB's `distinct()` method returns a raw JavaScript array of unique values.

tickets.title: Filter Active Todos (Equality)
tickets.description:
Fetch only the `title` of todos that have a status of 'pending'. Hide the `_id` field.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title FROM todos WHERE status = 'pending';
```
tasks: Fetch only the `title` of todos that have a status of 'pending'. Hide the `_id` field.
hints: Use projection `{ title: 1, _id: 0 }` in the second argument of find().

tickets.title: Comparison Operators
tickets.description:
Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority greater than 1. Hide the `_id` field.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority > 1;
```
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority greater than 1. Hide the `_id` field.
learning_objectives: Filter data using comparison operators like `$gt`.

tickets.title: Logical Operators (AND / OR / NOT)
tickets.description:
Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority of 3 AND status is 'pending'. Hide the `_id` field.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority = 3 AND status = 'pending';
```
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos that have a priority of 3 AND status is 'pending'. Hide the `_id` field.
common_mistakes: Using explicit $and unnecessarily or using incorrect syntax.
hints: In MongoDB, fields in the query object are implicitly ANDed together.

tickets.title: The IN Operator
tickets.description:
Fetch the `title` of todos where the status is IN ('pending', 'completed'). Hide the `_id` field.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title FROM todos WHERE status IN ('pending', 'completed');
```
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos where the status is IN ('pending', 'completed'). Hide the `_id` field.
learning_objectives: Filter against a list of values using `$in`.
common_mistakes: Using multiple OR conditions instead of $in.

tickets.title: The BETWEEN Operator
tickets.description:
Fetch the `title` of todos where priority is BETWEEN 1 AND 3. Hide the `_id` field.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title FROM todos WHERE priority BETWEEN 1 AND 3;
```
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos where priority is BETWEEN 1 AND 3. Hide the `_id` field.
learning_objectives: Filter within a range using `$gte` and `$lte`.
common_mistakes: Using only one boundary or wrong operator keys.

tickets.title: The LIKE Operator
tickets.description:
Find all todos where the title contains the word 'database'. For now, perform a standard pattern match using the string `"database"`.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT * FROM todos WHERE title LIKE '%database%';
```
tasks: Find all todos where the title contains the word 'database'. For now, perform a standard pattern match using the string `"database"`.
common_mistakes: Using SQL wildcard % characters in MongoDB.

tickets.title: Exists Operator ($exists)
tickets.description:
Fetch the `title` of todos that contain a `due_date` field. Hide the `_id` field.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title FROM todos WHERE due_date IS NOT NULL;
```
tasks: Fetch the `title` of todos that contain a `due_date` field. Hide the `_id` field.
common_mistakes: Using { due_date: null } which checks for null or missing values instead of checking existence.
